public_body: Fall River Superintendent Of Schools Search Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Committee credibly did not receive the minutes request, which its spam filter deleted. The AG noted concern about the late response and declined to review the new allegations raised on further review.

allegations.summary: Committee allegedly failed to timely respond to a June 2024 emailed request for open and executive session minutes of all its meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We credit the Committee’s explanation that Ms. Larrivee did not receive the June 6, 2024, request for meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: On further review, complainant claimed the minutes were approved by the School Committee rather than the Search Committee; the AG declined to review because it was not in the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: We find that these allegations were not clearly raised in the original complaint and thus we do not review their merits.

allegations.summary: On further review, complainant claimed the minutes were improperly redacted; the AG declined to review because the allegation was not in the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: The Division only has the authority to interpret and provide guidance with respect to the Open Meeting Law, and we do not decide whether the Public Records Law may authorize the Committee to redact minutes.

remedy: No further remedial action ordered; the Committee was reminded of its obligations to respond to minutes requests within 10 days and to complaints within 14 business days, and was provided copies of minutes.
remedy_passage: Where the Committee has provided copies of minutes, we order no further remedial action.
